governanceNotes: D1 batch 68 (2026-09-26): identity deferred (SELF-LIMITED COURSE plus zero located secondary-outcome quantification plus continuum with the capitellar osteochondritis-dissecans spectrum). The only located outcome series (seven elbows, mean 37 months follow-up; PMID 40949535) reports complete epiphyseal healing at a mean 12 months, well-remodeled capitella, and full sports return for all patients after nonoperative treatment - a benign self-limiting course with no sequela quantification. Candidate outcomes fail on the located evidence: (i) elbow osteoarthritis - zero located quantification after Panner disease (the favorable-remodeling series argues against a degenerative sequela, though seven elbows cannot exclude a rare one); (ii) loose bodies and fragment instability - manifestations within the capitellar osteochondrosis spectrum whose adolescent-onset entity (osteochondritis dissecans of the capitellum) is a distinct adjacent construct (continuum/identity-duplication guard; the OCD literature is that family's evidence, ME-29); (iii) persistent elbow pain and range-of-motion limitation - persistence of the primary condition (constitutive proximity), documented in the same series as resolving with remodeling; (iv) ulnar neuropathy and other compression sequelae - zero located quantification. Reopening conditions: (a) a long-term cohort quantifying elbow pain, range of motion, or osteoarthritis incidence after radiographically confirmed Panner disease; or (b) a governance decision folding Panner disease into a capitellar-osteochondrosis identity family alongside osteochondritis dissecans.
